name: Masaki Motoharu
source:
Masaki is a student at a second-rate university who was graduated from Hanegasaki High. He is working part-time job as a botanist at a flower shop. Pretty outgoing and blunt, he's got that "mature-guy" appeal. He's the only one of the dateable guys in the game who drives a car.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side:_2nd_Kiss#Male_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
